title: Behind Vauren Beastborn: We’re a 2-person dev team from Spain who spent the last 18 months turning a dream into a turn-based tactical card game!
author: VaurensBeastBorn
selftext:
Hi! We are a 2-friends indie team based in Valencia, Spain, pursuing a shared dream: creating our very own video game.



For the past 18 months, we’ve been developing Vauren Beastborn, a F2P PvP TCG centered around turn-based strategic beast combat, as a small team, we wanted to deliver a polished experience efficiently, so we embraced generative AI tools to assist us with concept drafting, icons, base illustrations, and code snippets—helping us accelerate our progress while keeping our core creative vision intact.



Meet the Team:



Aharon (Programming & Tech): Single handedly engineered the game in Unity, managing system architecture, animations, and visual polish.



Víctor (Design & Audio): Created the world lore, game design, original soundtrack, and led playtesting & balancing.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5064720/Vaurens\_BeastBorn/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5064720/Vaurens_BeastBorn/)

Our Steam demo is releasing soon, and we’ve just launched our official store page and social channels.If you enjoy tactical card games, adding Vauren Beastborn to your Steam Wishlist would be an incredible help to our small team. Of course, if you are also working on a project or game, let us know so we can return the support! 

Thanks for your time and support,

Best regards,

Aharon & Víctor

Vauren Beastborn
